solves.reasoning: passage: 'the present is normally more or less _____ to those who participate in it. It is the unthought background... like water to a fish, or air to a dove.' The present is unseen, like invisible water to a fish → invisible
regarding the ________(motivate) to follow instructions — 'the' 뒤 명사 필요 → motivation
superior=우수한. 반의어: 1.adequate(충분한) 2.notable(눈에 띄는) 3.identical(동일한) 4.inferior(열등한) → inferior=4

Q4 markers: ①enjoyment(mass ____ through media), ②stable(shared ____), ③distribution(economically ____), ④fulfillment. 원문: mass distribution, shared enjoyment, economically unstable, unique fulfillment. ②stable→shared stable은 부적절, shared enjoyment가 원문 → ②
(A) Focal points — focal이 맞는 용어. (B) others coordinate — 초점을 중심으로 조율. (C) still be lively — 활기차다가 맞음 (deserted는 반대). → Focal/coordinate/lively = ②
'a state of balance between opposing forces' = equilibrium(균형). 1.indication 2.coordination 3.outcome 4.equilibrium → 4
retain=유지하다. 1.maintain(유지) 2.release(방출) 3.destroy(파괴) 4.acquire(획득) → maintain=1
(A) 'culturally dated film' → dated=구식의. (B) 'letter was dated June 15' → dated=날짜가 적힌. → (A)구식의-(B)날짜가 적힌 = ②
'younger audiences favor social media... older audiences __________' → older audiences prefer traditional media. → 'indicate a preference for traditional media' = ①
'main frame or body of a vehicle' = chassis. 1.engine 2.wheel 3.chassis 4.antenna → 3
play a prominent role in ________(deliver) — 전치사 in 다음 동명사 → delivering
'belongs to a period other than the one being represented, chronological inconsistency' = anachronism(시대착오). 1.anachronism 2.narrative 3.endorsement 4.category → 1
①denied: 원문 'ease their immediate concerns' → denied는 'ease'를 대체 → to denied their concerns는 비문법적이고 의미도 반대. ②subjective(맞음), ③ease→argued(맞음, argued가 원문), ④preference(맞음). ①denied가 가장 명백히 부적절 → ①
'turning to _____ sources such as television and radio' — TV/radio는 traditional media → traditional=③
①difference(맞음), ②predictably('whimsically unpredictable'이 원문, predictably는 의미상 반대로 부적절), ③whimsical(맞음), ④rational(맞음) → ②
whimsically=변덕스럽게. 반의어: deliberately=의도적으로/계획적으로. 1.capriciously(변덕스러운=유사어) 2.erratically(불규칙한=유사어) 3.randomly(무작위=유사어) 4.deliberately(의도적=반의어) → 4
①ritualistic(맞음), ②abandon(원문 retain — they retain their power of fascination → abandon은 반대로 부적절), ③prize(맞음), ④sustainable(맞음) → ②
(A) 'people are more likely to turn to social media' → turn to=향하다. (B) 'turn the key clockwise' → turn=돌리다. → (A)향하다-(B)돌리다 = ③
'dated historical films that __________' — context: dated films read past in terms of their own present (anachronisms reflective of bygone present). → 'read the past in terms of their present' = ①
(A) 'strike up a conversation' → strike up=시작하다. (B) 'workers decided to strike until demands met' → strike=파업하다. → (A)시작하다-(B)파업하다 = ③
